hushfacebook.title: v0.24.0
hushfacebook.body:
This one moves to Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 and needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer, so update Manager and grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. Every patch now goes in on the Android 9 and 10 build too. There's a lot new here. The next reel can play in the background, groups can keep the tab bar, and a tap on a feed video can bring up a pause button instead of opening Reels. Stories can lose their reply bar and Up next card, Facebook can go through a proxy you name (handy for VLESS), and a tablet can keep the feed in a column down the middle. On the fix side, reels fit the screen on a tablet held sideways and behind see-through bars, and `Play saved videos in a row` no longer stops on a saved post or shakes between videos. The tab bar also comes all the way back when you scroll to the top, and on Android 17 a close for using too much memory leaves a crash file and counts toward safe mode.

New in this release

- `Next reel in the background` under Video and audio, for use with `Keep playing in the background`. When a reel playing in the background ends, the next reel Reels had loaded plays instead of the same one again, and you come back to Facebook on the last one played. Facebook doesn't load more reels while it's in the background, so once those run out the last one plays again. It starts off. (#524)

- `Keep the tab bar in groups` in the tab bar settings. Facebook opens a group on a page of its own with no tab bar, so the only way to another tab was Back. With this on, a group keeps the tab bar along the bottom, and tapping a tab takes you straight there. It works while the tab bar is at the bottom and starts off. (#503)

- `Show reactions on the Like button` under News feed moves a post's reaction icons from the far end of the row under it onto the Like button, right before the count, the way the summary line used to read. The button still likes and reacts like before. A video that shows its views there gets one Like icon, or your own reaction once you react. It starts off, and `Hide the reaction preview on posts` wins when both are on. (#541)

- `Tap shows a pause button on feed videos` under Video and audio stops a tap from opening a feed video in Reels. The tap brings up a big play/pause button in the middle of the video and the video keeps playing. Tap the button to pause or play, or tap the video again while it shows to open it. It starts off, and with Tap to play on it needs Inline feed video controls on too. (#538)

- `Hide the live video comment bar` under Comments and writing takes the comment box and the row of reactions off the bottom of a live video, so a stray tap won't send a reaction or open the keyboard. The live comments stay. It starts off. (#537)

- `Ignore taps beside the buttons` under News feed keeps a tap on the empty part of the row under a post, between the buttons and the reaction icons, from opening the comments or who reacted. Handy when you're aiming for a video's seek bar just above. It starts off. (#540)

- `Hide the Follow button` under Stories takes Follow off the top of a story from someone you don't follow. It starts off. (#543)

- `Hide the reply bar` under Stories takes the bar off the bottom of other people's stories, so the repost button, the Send message box and the quick reactions can't be tapped by accident. It starts off. (#542)

- `Hide the Up next card` under Stories starts the next stories right away, without the Up next card counting down over the first one. It starts off. (#544)

- New `Drag along the bottom edge` under Video and audio, for `Thin line seek bar`. While you drag the thin line it stays on the video's bottom edge, a bit thicker, with the time in the middle above it, instead of rising into the full bar. It starts off. (#539)

The story pauses while the question is up, and only Continue sends the reaction. Cancel, Back or a tap outside sends nothing and the story plays on. It's part of `Ask before a like` and starts off. - `Hide who reacted under posts` under News feed takes away the line under a post that names a friend or Page who reacted, like "Name and others reacted". It's off until you turn it on. (#483)

- A video opened from a post with several photos or videos now has `Download to phone` in the three-dot menu at the top. (#509)

- `Back to Clean mode` under Reels and Watch puts a reel back in Clean mode by itself after you bring its buttons back. Pick when: once the comments or a menu you opened close, or after 3, 5 or 10 seconds without touching the screen. It starts on Never. (#519)

- `Hide the line along the tab bar` under Tabs and navigation takes away the thin line Facebook draws along the edge of the tab bar, on every tab. It starts off, and a change shows on the next tab you tap. (#521)

- With `Hide posts you've already seen` or another switch that hides a lot of the feed, Home fills in by itself when you open Facebook fresh. - With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a video you tap after it played for a while in the feed opens alone too. Other changes

- Hushfacebook now patches Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 and no longer takes 587. On a 64-bit phone download the (arm64-v8a) (120-480dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615136, and on a 32-bit phone the (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615135. Update Facebook before you patch.

- You need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer now, since the patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0 and older Managers turn the bundle down. Update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.

- The README is about half as long. The patch list moved to [docs/patches.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/patches.md) and the help topics to [docs/help.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/help.md), and the README links to each topic.

- The changelog starts at 0.20.0 now, so Morphe Manager has a lot less to download when it shows what changed. Versions 0.1.0 to 0.19.0 are in the [changelog archive](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/changelog-archive.md), word for word.

- `Hide create story cards` under Stories now also takes out the full screen "continue the story" card, the one asking you to share a recent moment from your gallery with a Create story button. (#521)

- With `Clean mode button on reels` on, Facebook's button for leaving Clean mode now sits right where the sidebar's Clean mode button was, so the same spot turns it on and off. It takes that spot from your last tap on the sidebar button in that viewer. (#391)

- `Hold a feed photo to react` and `Hold a feed video to react` open the reactions right by your finger now, instead of down by the Like button, so there's no long slide to reach one. Once you let go, a tap anywhere off them closes them without reacting. Their `Reaction` list has a new `Slide to pick one` too: slide to a reaction and let go, and letting go anywhere else closes them. (#454)

- The bug form now requires the Facebook file you patched. (#528)

- When a Debug report says why Facebook went away last time, it now names Android 17's two new reasons, the memory limiter and an anomaly, instead of showing a bare number. (#528)

- With `Keep playing in the background` on, a reel you swiped to in Reels keeps its sound after you leave Facebook. Before, only a video you'd started with a tap carried on, so a reel you'd swiped to went quiet. Reels playing in the feed or in a story still stop when you leave. (#524)

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too, and the oldest ones are in its [archive](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/changelog-archive.md).

How to update

This release targets Facebook 588.0.0.42.55.

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `588.0.0.42.55`. On most phones that's build `707615136`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `707615135`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

- With `See-through bars` on, the strip behind the clock and battery icons is frosted glass too on Android 12 and newer, so the glass runs from the top bar up to the edge of the screen instead of stopping under a solid band. (#507)

Left blank it stays at the 25 it always used. `Smooth fade` next to it eases them out and back in instead of switching at once, and it starts off. (#523)

- A crash deep in Facebook's native code or a freeze now leaves a `crash-` file in Download/Hushfacebook too, and so does Android 17 closing Facebook for using too much memory. Facebook writes it the next time it starts, even when that start runs paused, with what closed it and Android's own note about it. A freeze keeps the main thread's part of Android's trace. One from before your last update or reinstall says when that was and marks the versions unknown, since they could be the old build's. Before, only a Java crash got a file. (#528)

- `Video buffer` under Video and audio picks how much of a video loads before it starts and while it plays. Low starts a video once half a second has loaded and keeps less loaded ahead, so it uses less data. Medium waits for 1.5 seconds and Maximum for 3, and both keep more loaded ahead (up to a minute on Maximum), which can help when the connection is slow. It starts at Facebook's choice, which leaves everything as Facebook has it, and a change shows on the video that's playing within a moment. (#526)

- `Recently watched in the Menu` under Menu adds a Recently watched row to Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu, right after Watch history. Tap it and the list `Remember what you watch` keeps opens over the Menu, so you don't have to go through the settings to get back to a reel or video. It needs `Resume long videos` and starts off. (#529)

- `Center the feed on big screens` under Appearance keeps the feed and Facebook's other lists in a column down the middle on a tablet or an unfolded phone, so posts stop stretching from one edge of the screen to the other. Reels still get the whole screen. It starts off. (#531)

- Four new switches for the top of a post, all off until you turn them on. `Show full names` under News feed lets a long name wrap onto a second line instead of ending in "...". `Hide songs under names` leaves the song out of the line under the name, with no gap where it was, and `Bold post times` makes the time or date there bold like the name. `Dark box behind feed video names` under Reels and Watch puts a name drawn on top of a feed video on the same dark box reel names can get. (#533)

Fixes

- With the tab bar at the bottom sliding away as you scroll, the tabs come all the way back when you scroll back to the top. After a short scroll near the top they used to stop short and sit over the gesture bar until you scrolled again. With `Tab bar while scrolling` on `Hides while scrolling`, Home also opens at the top after a restart. Facebook moved the feed down a little a few seconds after it opened, which slid both bars away before you'd touched anything.

- On a tablet or an unfolded phone held sideways, the reels you swipe to on the Reels tab fit the screen, with the caption, buttons and seek bar showing. Facebook works the reel's height out for the screen held upright, so turned on its side the bottom of every reel ran off the screen. (#531)

- `Play saved videos in a row` keeps going past a saved post. When the next card in Saved was a post and not a video, the post opened and the run of videos stopped there. Now that post closes again on its own and the card after it plays, and the screen stays black while it does, so you don't see the post flash by. Posts you open yourself stay open. (#404)

- `Play saved videos in a row` doesn't shake anymore when you swipe to the next or previous saved video. Facebook first shows a new video a little lower and smaller, under the status bar, then jumps it up to fill the screen. Opening one video by hand you barely notice it, but the run opens a new one on every swipe. Now the screen stays black for that moment and the video shows once it's in place. (#404)

- `3-dot menu items to hide` takes Interested, Not interested and Your algorithm off a reel's More sheet now. They sit in a card at the top of that sheet that's built apart from the rest, so ticking them only hid them from posts. Your algorithm is the reel's name for a post's Manage your Feed, so the list calls that row `Manage your Feed / Your algorithm`. Three more reel rows read the way the sheet shows them too: `Quality settings`, `Request community note` and `Something went wrong` were "Best guess post", "Other" and "Bug". (#475)

- `Seek bar on feed videos` gets out of the way while comments are open. On a phone with the three navigation buttons it showed just above them, under the comments. (#535)

- `Times on the seek bar` and `Full length on the seek bar` work with `Thin line seek bar` now. The times sit just above the line's two ends, whether you're dragging or not. Before, the thin line turned them off. (#487)

- `Hide prompts and promos under reels` also takes the "Made with Edits" pill off the corner of a video in your feed now. That pill is a different piece from the line under a reel's caption, so the switch only caught the line. (#314)

- With `Tap the bar to seek` on, the three dots and other buttons that sit just above a reel's progress line open again. Before, a tap on the bottom of the three dots in a saved reel jumped the video instead of opening the menu. A tap on the line itself still seeks.

- A saved reel you open from your library on the Reels tab fits the screen again. Its bottom no longer runs under the comment box, so Facebook's way out of Clear mode is easy to tap.

- With `Show the post date on reels` on, the date under a reel's author stays put. On a reel with a song, the song line no longer scrolls the date out of sight, and on the others the line holds on the date instead of turning over to the location or "New for you" a few seconds later. (#503)

- A Facebook that crashes or gets closed while you're signed out now leaves its `crash-` file too. Before, a start that stayed on the login screen never wrote it. (#528)

- With `Show the post date on reels` on, a reel shows its date once. Facebook is trying out a second date at the end of the caption on some accounts, and that one now stays out while the date under the author shows. (#503)

- With `Keep playing in the background` on, a video playing in the picture-in-picture window keeps its sound when you lock the phone and plays on in the window when you unlock it. (#495)

- With `Open comments at` on `Full height` or `Half height`, Comment on the Reels tab now slides the regular sheet straight up over the reel. Before, the reel shrank into the top of the screen first, the way Facebook's split view opens, and at full height the sheet covered it a moment later. (#501)

- With the tab bar at the bottom and `See-through bars` or `Rounded tab bar` on, a reel's video now runs the whole screen, down under the tab bar and the gesture bar. Its name, caption and buttons sit above the tab bar instead of behind it and move with the reel as you swipe. (#503, #466)

- With the tab bar at the bottom and `See-through bars` on, the Reels tab now runs the reel up behind the status bar too, so the time and battery sit over the video instead of a solid strip. The Reels title and its buttons stay just below the status bar. (#466)

- With `See-through bars` and `Hide the video comment box` on, a reel or video you open from a post runs down under the gesture bar too, instead of stopping above a dark band. Its caption, its buttons, the seek bar and the Up next card sit just above the gesture bar. (#466)

- With the tab bar at the top and `See-through bars` on, the Reels seek bar now sits just above the gesture bar instead of on it, so dragging it doesn't take you to the home screen. (#466)

- `Fold long text` now holds to the number of lines you picked on posts it used to miss, including the first ones in the feed. Comments fold by how they actually wrap on your screen, so 8 lines means 8 lines, with See more on the last of them instead of a line further down. A video's caption follows the count you picked for posts. (#506)

- The download button under a post and the post's menu now find videos that sit behind a photo or inside an album. A post with several videos gets `Save all videos`. (#509)

- Your own story stays first in the tray when `Move seen stories to the end` or a similar switch is on. (#510)

- The progress line on a reel opened from the feed sits above the gesture bar instead of under it. (#469)

- `Hide the tab bar on the Reels tab` no longer leaves a grey line under the Reels title when your tabs are at the top. The line comes back with the bar on the other tabs. (#508)

- `Seek bar on feed videos` stays out of Facebook's own video viewer, so a video you open from the feed only shows Facebook's bar. (#505)

- A long press on a reel's Download, Cast or Clean mode button no longer opens an empty gray box. (#518)

- With `Hide the tab bar on the Reels tab` on, a reel's time, caption and seek bar sit above the gesture bar again, so the seek bar can be tapped and held. (#516)

- With `Tap to play` on, video stories play by themselves again, the way Facebook plays them. Before, the story after the first one, or one you swiped to, could sit frozen at the start, since a tap on a story moves on instead of playing it. Stories that wait for you are what `Video stories wait for a tap` is for. (#521)

- A Threads post in your feed opens that post in Threads instead of the Threads home feed. The 0.23.0 fix missed the redirect link Facebook now sends the card through, which Threads opens on the feed, and Threads' list form of the post number. Both open the post now. (#385)

- With `View stories anonymously` on, a story you watch counts as watched on your phone again, so its ring turns gray and `Hide seen stories` can take it out. Hushfacebook read the wrong flag on the viewer and took every story for a quick peek, so none of them were kept as watched. (#165, #514)

- `Show the post date on reels` now dates a video posted in a group too. Facebook's full screen viewer gives a group's video no date line under its author, so the date goes after the poster's name, like "Ana Lima · 3 weeks ago". (#520)

- With `Hide posts you've already seen` or another switch that hides a lot of the feed, Home fills in by itself when you open Facebook fresh. When the first pages were all posts the switch hides, Home sat on stories, the Reels shelf and its loading row until you swiped, since Facebook only asks for more posts as the feed scrolls. It now asks again on its own a few times, and a swipe still asks too. (#493)

- With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a video you tap after it played for a while in the feed opens alone too. Facebook had already loaded it by then, so the first batch it handed the viewer held only the videos after yours, and the 0.23.0 trim let one of them through. That batch is skipped now. (#457)

- On Android 17, Facebook getting closed for using too much memory in its first minute now counts toward safe mode the way a crash or a freeze does, so three starts in a row that end like that open Facebook with Hushfacebook paused. It only counts while you're using Facebook. A swipe away, a force stop or Android clearing it out in the background still doesn't. (#528)

- Every patch goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build of 588 (build 707615023) once Hush Unpacker has unpacked it. With 0.23.0 a number of them failed there and had to be unchecked before patching. The README names the bundle to take on Android 9 and 10. (#102, #422)

Other changes

- Hushfacebook now patches Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 and no longer takes 587. On a 64-bit phone download the (arm64-v8a) (120-480dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615136, and on a 32-bit phone the (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615135. Update Facebook before you patch.

- You need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer now, since the patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0 and older Managers turn the bundle down. Update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.

- The README is about half as long. The patch list moved to [docs/patches.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/patches.md) and the help topics to [docs/help.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/help.md), and the README links to each topic.

- The changelog starts at 0.20.0 now, so Morphe Manager has a lot less to download when it shows what changed. Versions 0.1.0 to 0.19.0 are in the [changelog archive](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/changelog-archive.md), word for word.

- `Hide create story cards` under Stories now also takes out the full screen "continue the story" card, the one asking you to share a recent moment from your gallery with a Create story button. (#521)

- With `Clean mode button on reels` on, Facebook's button for leaving Clean mode now sits right where the sidebar's Clean mode button was, so the same spot turns it on and off. It takes that spot from your last tap on the sidebar button in that viewer. (#391)

- `Hold a feed photo to react` and `Hold a feed video to react` open the reactions right by your finger now, instead of down by the Like button, so there's no long slide to reach one. Once you let go, a tap anywhere off them closes them without reacting. Their `Reaction` list has a new `Slide to pick one` too: slide to a reaction and let go, and letting go anywhere else closes them. (#454)

- The bug form now requires the Facebook file you patched. (#528)

- When a Debug report says why Facebook went away last time, it now names Android 17's two new reasons, the memory limiter and an anomaly, instead of showing a bare number. (#528)

- With `Keep playing in the background` on, a reel you swiped to in Reels keeps its sound after you leave Facebook. Before, only a video you'd started with a tap carried on, so a reel you'd swiped to went quiet. Reels playing in the feed or in a story still stop when you leave. (#524)

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too, and the oldest ones are in its [archive](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/changelog-archive.md).

How to update

This release targets Facebook 588.0.0.42.55.

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `588.0.0.42.55`. On most phones that's build `707615136`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `707615135`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

hushmessenger.title: v0.30.0
hushmessenger.body:
HushMessenger for Messenger 587.0.0.54.96, all 19 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. 98 patches. Calls can show live captions now, and unsent messages can stay in encrypted chats too. You can blur the chat list behind menus, send an Instant from your gallery, see when someone you track comes online and hide the Stories tab. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Hide Stories tab` is a new switch under Navigation. It takes the Stories tab out of the bottom bar after a restart, like the People and Notifications switches do. Refs #170.
- `Use the phone's camera app` has a new `Ask photo or video` option. The camera button asks which one you want and opens your camera app for it, so you can record videos too. Refs #168.
- `Mark as seen button` is a new switch under `View stories anonymously`. Stories you open get an eye with a slash through it while you're watching anonymously. Tap it and you show up in that story's viewer list, the way you would without the patch. The next story stays anonymous. Refs #169.
- `Send Instants from your gallery` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your gallery app, and the photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Refs #161.
- `Special contacts` is a new switch under Chat menu. Press and hold a chat with one person and tap Track this person. From then on HushMessenger writes down when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, using only what Messenger already shows you. Settings lists everyone you track with the last thing seen, their history, and buttons to clear it or stop tracking. You can track up to 50 people per account, and it all stays on this phone. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #163.
- `Blur behind menus` is a new switch under Theme. When you press and hold a chat, the chat list behind the menu blurs like it does on an iPhone, and so does the screen behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets. It needs Android 12 or newer. Phones that can't blur behind a window (some Samsungs can't, and battery saver turns it off on others) get Messenger's own screen blurred under the menu instead. The `iPhone look` quick setup turns it on too. Experimental, and it starts off. Refs #162.
- `Live captions on calls` is a new switch under Calls. While you're on a call, what the other people say shows up as captions near the bottom of the screen, made by your phone's own speech recognition. Under the switch you pick the language they speak and the one you want to read, and if your phone can translate on the device the captions come out in your language. `Read captions aloud` reads each one in the phone's voice, and `Lower their voice while reading` turns them down while it does. It needs Android 13 or newer. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #159.
- `Row in the chat menu`, under `Keep a message log`, adds Message log to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. Tap it and the log opens on just that chat's messages, and `All chats` takes you back to everything. It starts off. Refs #172.
- If `GmsCore support` is patched in but microG-RE isn't installed (or is turned off), the top of the HushMessenger settings says so now, since Messenger can't get notifications through Google's push service that way. `Copy setup` also gets a `Push:` line saying which push service Messenger is set up to use. Refs #173.
- The settings screen is in Turkish now. Refs #160.
- The settings screen is in Thai now, translated by MangaThatsFine. Refs #166.
- Switches that came with an update get a dot next to their name until you've seen their page, and so do their section and tab. TalkBack says "New" after the name. Refs #149.
- Material You gets a `Palette style` picker with the same choices as Android's wallpaper settings: Tonal spot, Neutral, Vibrant, Expressive, Rainbow, Fruit salad and Monochrome. A new `Light mode grays` switch tints Messenger's light-mode grays with your palette too, and white and black stay put. Refs #155.
- `Bigger chat preview` gives the preview most of the screen when you press and hold a chat, and you can scroll back through the chat right there. The menu under it stays short and scrolls. Refs #151.
- `Hide chat menu items` lets you pick what the press-and-hold menu on a chat shows. Press and hold any chat once and its items show up under the switch, ready to hide the ones you never use. Messenger always keeps at least one of its own. Refs #153.
- Two new switches under Navigation. `Hide the tab bar while scrolling` slides the bottom tab bar away as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. `Floating tab bar` turns on the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats. Both take a Messenger restart. Refs #154.

### Fixes and changes

- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer (or Desktop to 2.1.0) before you add this release.
- The patches now take Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 and drop 586. All 19 of 587's builds on APKMirror are covered. Refs #145.
- Videos in chat heads play like the rest of the chat now. On some phones Messenger 587 draws videos on a layer of their own, and a chat head could show that layer as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. In a chat head, or a bubble on Android 12 and newer, the video is drawn inside the chat instead. Videos in the app itself are unchanged. Refs #104.
- The switches for the menu you get when you press and hold a chat moved out of Inbox into their own Chat menu group, both in HushMessenger settings and in Morphe's patch list. Inbox had gotten long.
- The message log keeps up to 20,000 messages now, up from 5,000. Refs #172.
- `Keep unsent messages` works in encrypted chats too. When someone unsends a message there, it stays in the chat marked [unsent], as long as Messenger already showed you its words (in the chat or a notification) and hasn't restarted since. Refs #172.
- With `Spoof package version` on, parts of Messenger still saw the raised version number, like its background job check and its crash reports, because they get the app's version info in roundabout ways the patch didn't follow. Now every place Messenger reads a version number asks first whose it is. Messenger's own answers with the build you patched, and other apps keep the number Android gives. Refs #120.
- `Hide call buttons` and the call confirmation work again. Messenger 586 started wrapping a chat's audio and video call buttons in another button, and the patch was looking at the wrapper. Refs #146.
- `Ask before a call` asks on every call button now, including the ones outside a chat's top bar. A business chat and the New message screen build their own call buttons, so a tap there used to start the call right away. Refs #172.
- `Hide call buttons` takes the call buttons off business chats and the New message screen too. Those two screens build their own, so they used to stay. Refs #146, #172.
- On 586 a call crashed as it started when `Record calls` was on. The recording setup now takes its size from Messenger's own instead of 585's. Refs #146.
- The Experimental badge stays on one line. A long title used to squeeze it into a tall strip of one or two letters per line. Now it sits under the title when the two don't fit side by side. Refs #157.
- When a Meta-signed Messenger was uninstalled with its data kept, the install check told you to patch a higher version, which can't work for a build Meta signed. It points you at `Clone install` now, or at removing the leftover if you don't need its data. Refs #156.
- Patching goes faster. The code that finds where each patch goes had grown too big for Java to compile, so it ran slowly. It's split into smaller pieces now, and the slowest step takes about half as long on a computer. Refs #148, #150.
- `Android Auto messages` also works on accounts where Messenger leaves the car part out of its notifications. Messenger only adds it when a setting on Meta's side says so, and the switch turns that on. Refs #75.
- `Report a problem` reads Messenger's notification channels right again. Messenger 586 started adding a code to the end of each channel's name, so the report listed every one of them as unknown. Refs #158.
- A Root Mount over a different Messenger build now gets a warning instead of a mystery crash. Several builds share one version name, and mounting a patch made from one over another crashed chat heads. HushMessenger names the build Android has installed in a toast, under the name in settings and in `Copy setup`, so you know which one to patch. Refs #158.
- `Hide Your story when sharing` now also stops the "Chats or Your story" question some phones ask on every share. Xiaomi's share sheet groups an app's targets, and Messenger switched its story target back on at every launch, so you had to pick each time. With the switch on, sharing a photo goes straight to Chats. Refs #147.
- `Log chats that don't notify`, under `Keep a message log`, also saves messages from muted and restricted chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, without a notification. Those chats used to stop before the log could see the message. Now they go through to the log and the notification is dropped right before it would show. Unsends still get marked, and auto reply leaves those chats alone. Refs #143.
- Patching in Morphe Manager holds less memory. One of the `Android Auto messages` lookups kept a copy of every APK it had read for as long as the patches stayed loaded, so patching a second time carried the first APK along. It lets go once it's done now. Refs #75.
- Patching does less work. The steps that look for chat heads, Material You colors and home screen shortcuts now skip code that can't match before reading it, and in testing on a computer a full patch used about a fifth less processor time. The patched app comes out exactly the same.
- Patching is quicker again. The step that finds where each switch goes used to read through Messenger's code once per switch, and now it reads it once for all of them. In testing on a computer a full patch took a little over half the processor time it did before, and the patched app is byte for byte the same.
- `GmsCore support` only tells Messenger that Google Play services is there while microG-RE is installed and turned on. It used to say yes either way, so without microG-RE Messenger kept reaching for an app that wasn't there. Now it carries on the way it does on a phone with no Play services. On Android 14 and newer, a phone without microG-RE also keeps Android's own sign-in route, so a password manager can still offer a saved login.
- A chat pinned with `Pin more chats` loses its pin mark as soon as you unpin it. The mark used to stay on the chat until Messenger restarted, even though Unpin had worked. Refs #56.

### Behind the scenes

- For developers, `scripts/CompatReport.java` is a small launcher now. The report it runs lives in `scripts/compat/`, one file per group of patches instead of one file of nearly 12,000 lines, and you start it the same way as before.

### Reports this release changed something for

#56, #75, #104, #120, #143, #145, #146, #147, #148, #149, #150, #151, #153, #154, #155, #156, #157, #158, #159, #160, #161, #162, #163, #166, #168, #169, #170, #172 and #173.

Full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 587.0.0.54.96 first. On [APKMirror's 587.0.0.54.96 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-587-0-0-54-96-release/), take a build whose version code is 347415262, 347415267, 347415268, 347415280, 347415281, 347415284, 347415285, 347415295, 347415299, 347415301, 347415302, 347415333, 347415337, 347415348, 347415350, 347415351, 347415352, 347415354 or 347415355. APKMirror shows the code for each download, and a build posted there after this release may not be supported yet.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.5.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **98 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.30.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 19 Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

repos.title: v0.30.0
repos.body:
HushMessenger for Messenger 587.0.0.54.96, all 19 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. 98 patches. Calls can show live captions now, and unsent messages can stay in encrypted chats too. You can blur the chat list behind menus, send an Instant from your gallery, see when someone you track comes online and hide the Stories tab. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Hide Stories tab` is a new switch under Navigation. It takes the Stories tab out of the bottom bar after a restart, like the People and Notifications switches do. Refs #170.
- `Use the phone's camera app` has a new `Ask photo or video` option. The camera button asks which one you want and opens your camera app for it, so you can record videos too. Refs #168.
- `Mark as seen button` is a new switch under `View stories anonymously`. Stories you open get an eye with a slash through it while you're watching anonymously. Tap it and you show up in that story's viewer list, the way you would without the patch. The next story stays anonymous. Refs #169.
- `Send Instants from your gallery` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your gallery app, and the photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Refs #161.
- `Special contacts` is a new switch under Chat menu. Press and hold a chat with one person and tap Track this person. From then on HushMessenger writes down when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, using only what Messenger already shows you. Settings lists everyone you track with the last thing seen, their history, and buttons to clear it or stop tracking. You can track up to 50 people per account, and it all stays on this phone. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #163.
- `Blur behind menus` is a new switch under Theme. When you press and hold a chat, the chat list behind the menu blurs like it does on an iPhone, and so does the screen behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets. It needs Android 12 or newer. Phones that can't blur behind a window (some Samsungs can't, and battery saver turns it off on others) get Messenger's own screen blurred under the menu instead. The `iPhone look` quick setup turns it on too. Experimental, and it starts off. Refs #162.
- `Live captions on calls` is a new switch under Calls. While you're on a call, what the other people say shows up as captions near the bottom of the screen, made by your phone's own speech recognition. Under the switch you pick the language they speak and the one you want to read, and if your phone can translate on the device the captions come out in your language. `Read captions aloud` reads each one in the phone's voice, and `Lower their voice while reading` turns them down while it does. It needs Android 13 or newer. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #159.
- `Row in the chat menu`, under `Keep a message log`, adds Message log to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. Tap it and the log opens on just that chat's messages, and `All chats` takes you back to everything. It starts off. Refs #172.
- If `GmsCore support` is patched in but microG-RE isn't installed (or is turned off), the top of the HushMessenger settings says so now, since Messenger can't get notifications through Google's push service that way. `Copy setup` also gets a `Push:` line saying which push service Messenger is set up to use. Refs #173.
- The settings screen is in Turkish now. Refs #160.
- The settings screen is in Thai now, translated by MangaThatsFine. Refs #166.
- Switches that came with an update get a dot next to their name until you've seen their page, and so do their section and tab. TalkBack says "New" after the name. Refs #149.
- Material You gets a `Palette style` picker with the same choices as Android's wallpaper settings: Tonal spot, Neutral, Vibrant, Expressive, Rainbow, Fruit salad and Monochrome. A new `Light mode grays` switch tints Messenger's light-mode grays with your palette too, and white and black stay put. Refs #155.
- `Bigger chat preview` gives the preview most of the screen when you press and hold a chat, and you can scroll back through the chat right there. The menu under it stays short and scrolls. Refs #151.
- `Hide chat menu items` lets you pick what the press-and-hold menu on a chat shows. Press and hold any chat once and its items show up under the switch, ready to hide the ones you never use. Messenger always keeps at least one of its own. Refs #153.
- Two new switches under Navigation. `Hide the tab bar while scrolling` slides the bottom tab bar away as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. `Floating tab bar` turns on the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats. Both take a Messenger restart. Refs #154.

### Fixes and changes

- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer (or Desktop to 2.1.0) before you add this release.
- The patches now take Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 and drop 586. All 19 of 587's builds on APKMirror are covered. Refs #145.
- Videos in chat heads play like the rest of the chat now. On some phones Messenger 587 draws videos on a layer of their own, and a chat head could show that layer as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. In a chat head, or a bubble on Android 12 and newer, the video is drawn inside the chat instead. Videos in the app itself are unchanged. Refs #104.
- The switches for the menu you get when you press and hold a chat moved out of Inbox into their own Chat menu group, both in HushMessenger settings and in Morphe's patch list. Inbox had gotten long.
- The message log keeps up to 20,000 messages now, up from 5,000. Refs #172.
- `Keep unsent messages` works in encrypted chats too. When someone unsends a message there, it stays in the chat marked [unsent], as long as Messenger already showed you its words (in the chat or a notification) and hasn't restarted since. Refs #172.
- With `Spoof package version` on, parts of Messenger still saw the raised version number, like its background job check and its crash reports, because they get the app's version info in roundabout ways the patch didn't follow. Now every place Messenger reads a version number asks first whose it is. Messenger's own answers with the build you patched, and other apps keep the number Android gives. Refs #120.
- `Hide call buttons` and the call confirmation work again. Messenger 586 started wrapping a chat's audio and video call buttons in another button, and the patch was looking at the wrapper. Refs #146.
- `Ask before a call` asks on every call button now, including the ones outside a chat's top bar. A business chat and the New message screen build their own call buttons, so a tap there used to start the call right away. Refs #172.
- `Hide call buttons` takes the call buttons off business chats and the New message screen too. Those two screens build their own, so they used to stay. Refs #146, #172.
- On 586 a call crashed as it started when `Record calls` was on. The recording setup now takes its size from Messenger's own instead of 585's. Refs #146.
- The Experimental badge stays on one line. A long title used to squeeze it into a tall strip of one or two letters per line. Now it sits under the title when the two don't fit side by side. Refs #157.
- When a Meta-signed Messenger was uninstalled with its data kept, the install check told you to patch a higher version, which can't work for a build Meta signed. It points you at `Clone install` now, or at removing the leftover if you don't need its data. Refs #156.
- Patching goes faster. The code that finds where each patch goes had grown too big for Java to compile, so it ran slowly. It's split into smaller pieces now, and the slowest step takes about half as long on a computer. Refs #148, #150.
- `Android Auto messages` also works on accounts where Messenger leaves the car part out of its notifications. Messenger only adds it when a setting on Meta's side says so, and the switch turns that on. Refs #75.
- `Report a problem` reads Messenger's notification channels right again. Messenger 586 started adding a code to the end of each channel's name, so the report listed every one of them as unknown. Refs #158.
- A Root Mount over a different Messenger build now gets a warning instead of a mystery crash. Several builds share one version name, and mounting a patch made from one over another crashed chat heads. HushMessenger names the build Android has installed in a toast, under the name in settings and in `Copy setup`, so you know which one to patch. Refs #158.
- `Hide Your story when sharing` now also stops the "Chats or Your story" question some phones ask on every share. Xiaomi's share sheet groups an app's targets, and Messenger switched its story target back on at every launch, so you had to pick each time. With the switch on, sharing a photo goes straight to Chats. Refs #147.
- `Log chats that don't notify`, under `Keep a message log`, also saves messages from muted and restricted chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, without a notification. Those chats used to stop before the log could see the message. Now they go through to the log and the notification is dropped right before it would show. Unsends still get marked, and auto reply leaves those chats alone. Refs #143.
- Patching in Morphe Manager holds less memory. One of the `Android Auto messages` lookups kept a copy of every APK it had read for as long as the patches stayed loaded, so patching a second time carried the first APK along. It lets go once it's done now. Refs #75.
- Patching does less work. The steps that look for chat heads, Material You colors and home screen shortcuts now skip code that can't match before reading it, and in testing on a computer a full patch used about a fifth less processor time. The patched app comes out exactly the same.
- Patching is quicker again. The step that finds where each switch goes used to read through Messenger's code once per switch, and now it reads it once for all of them. In testing on a computer a full patch took a little over half the processor time it did before, and the patched app is byte for byte the same.
- `GmsCore support` only tells Messenger that Google Play services is there while microG-RE is installed and turned on. It used to say yes either way, so without microG-RE Messenger kept reaching for an app that wasn't there. Now it carries on the way it does on a phone with no Play services. On Android 14 and newer, a phone without microG-RE also keeps Android's own sign-in route, so a password manager can still offer a saved login.
- A chat pinned with `Pin more chats` loses its pin mark as soon as you unpin it. The mark used to stay on the chat until Messenger restarted, even though Unpin had worked. Refs #56.

### Behind the scenes

- For developers, `scripts/CompatReport.java` is a small launcher now. The report it runs lives in `scripts/compat/`, one file per group of patches instead of one file of nearly 12,000 lines, and you start it the same way as before.

### Reports this release changed something for

#56, #75, #104, #120, #143, #145, #146, #147, #148, #149, #150, #151, #153, #154, #155, #156, #157, #158, #159, #160, #161, #162, #163, #166, #168, #169, #170, #172 and #173.

Full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 587.0.0.54.96 first. On [APKMirror's 587.0.0.54.96 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-587-0-0-54-96-release/), take a build whose version code is 347415262, 347415267, 347415268, 347415280, 347415281, 347415284, 347415285, 347415295, 347415299, 347415301, 347415302, 347415333, 347415337, 347415348, 347415350, 347415351, 347415352, 347415354 or 347415355. APKMirror shows the code for each download, and a build posted there after this release may not be supported yet.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.5.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **98 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.30.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 19 Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

hushfeed.title: v0.84.0
hushfeed.body:
Hushfeed v0.84.0 has 155 patches for global TikTok 47.9.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and 11 of them also work on TikTok Lite 47.8.2 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically.go`). It's built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you patch (or use morphe-desktop 2.3.0 on a computer). Older ones won't load it.

TikTok moves to 47.9.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key. Your login and settings carry over. You can unfollow everyone who doesn't follow you back in one go, and Long press or Double tap can name a video's song with Shazam. `UI scale` and `Smaller text sizes` make TikTok's whole interface smaller. Ghost mode's `Keep likes on this phone` turns the heart red without TikTok ever hearing about it. TikTok Lite gets its first patches too, starting with Hushfeed's settings and the Feed filter.

New in this release

- `Long press` and `Double tap` can now be set to `Save this video`. It saves the video on screen the way the save button does, with your download settings, mini drama episodes included. It's offered when Advanced downloads is patched in (#463).
- With `Watch LIVEs unseen` on, letting a host see you now lasts for that visit only. Leave the LIVE and you're hidden again the next time you open it. Tap the open eye to stay hidden on your next visit without leaving.
- Three new LIVE options in Playback change the profile card a tap on a name opens in a LIVE room. `LIVE profile card background` paints the card black, dark gray, light gray or white, and `LIVE profile card text` picks the color of its text, or Automatic for whichever of white and black stands out. Chips, buttons and boxes on the card keep TikTok's colors. `Hide rows on LIVE profile cards` takes off the rows you pick: upcoming LIVE events, products, the shop and its rating, group chat, the bulletin board, the gift gallery and festival honors. They all start off and apply the next time a card opens (#487).
- `UI scale` is new on the App page. Set its `UI size` below 100 to make TikTok's whole interface smaller, text and buttons alike, so more fits on screen. It takes 50 to 100 and needs a restart, and 100 changes nothing. It works together with `Smaller text sizes`. inxomnyaa sent it in a pull request (#477).
- `Smaller text sizes` is new on the App page. It adds three stops below the smallest size on TikTok's own Text size slider, in Settings and privacy > Accessibility, so text and everything around it can be smaller than TikTok allows. Pick one there, then restart TikTok. Turning the switch off puts TikTok back on its own smallest size. It starts off. inxomnyaa sent it in a pull request (#476).
- `Show the room ID and your connection`, with the other LIVE options in Playback, adds a small line to LIVE rooms with the room's ID and how your own connection to the stream is doing. That's ping, latency and download speed, the same numbers TikTok's player keeps for its own LIVE debug panel. A number the player doesn't have for a stream is left out, and nothing about the host's phone is shown. Tap the line to copy the room ID. It starts off (#487).
- `Account facts on profiles` shows two more lines, the account's gifter level and its SecUID, both from what TikTok already sent with the profile. A detail TikTok left out now says Unknown (TikTok didn't send it) in place of Not sent. Hushfeed shows the username and display name change dates exactly as TikTok sends them, so when an older change has no date, it's TikTok that left it out (#487).
- `Round the corners on profile grids`, with the other profile grid options under Interface, gives each video on a profile grid 8dp rounded corners. It works on your own profile, anyone else's, the Liked and Favorites tabs, and the videos inside a Favorites collection. It starts off and turns on or off as the grid scrolls, no restart needed (#487).
- With `More opens the comments` or `Caption above comments` on, the caption at the top of the comments now shows in the language the feed shows it in. If TikTok translates the caption (Always translate, or See translation on that video), the comments get TikTok's own translation, hashtags and mentions included, and See original keeps it as posted. A translation TikTok hasn't fetched yet leaves the caption as posted until the next time you open the comments (#488).
- `Exit with one Back` is new on the Feed tabs page. One Back on Home leaves TikTok, with no "Tap again to exit" toast. From any other tab, Back still goes to Home first, or to the tab `Open TikTok on` picks. It starts off and doesn't need a restart (#489).
- `Hide the pause icon` is new on the Feed screen page. A tap still pauses and plays the video, but the big play icon doesn't pop up over it anymore. It starts off and doesn't need a restart (#489).
- `Hide playable games` is new under Feed filter. It takes the mini games tagged Playable out of For You before they show. A creator on your exceptions list keeps theirs. It starts off and needs a restart (#486).
- `Hide the Tako bubble` also covers the Tako icon some accounts get in the home top bar. inxomnyaa found where TikTok sets it up and sent the hook in a pull request (#475).
- Two new Comment tools switches for the comment sheet (#479). `Always show the expand button in comments` gives every video's comments the button that stretches them over the whole screen, which TikTok only hands to some accounts. `Keep the video full size under comments` stops the video from shrinking into a small box when the comments open, so they cover its lower part instead. Both start off and take a TikTok restart.
- `Share any comment`, under Comments, lets you share a comment or send it to a friend when TikTok says it can't be shared. TikTok's server marks those comments, and with the switch on the long-press menu treats them like any other. The link it shares is the video's link with the comment's id on it, the same kind TikTok makes for every comment. It's part of Comment tools and starts off (#481).
- On TikTok's own bottom bar, `Glass lens on the current tab` is a thin outline now, white on a dark bar and dark on a light one, with nothing filled inside, so it doesn't sit on the icons like a heavy frame. Sliding across the tabs works the same. The glass, floating and see-through bars keep the glass bubble (#483).
- A name typed after an @ in a bio, like @First Last, opens TikTok's search on the Accounts tab now, where the person is usually the first row. It used to open the Top results. A typed @username still opens that profile, and `Tap @names in bios` turns all of it off (#247).
- `Identify the song with Shazam` is a new choice for Long press and Double tap, the corners included. It takes 12 seconds from the middle of the video's sound, turns them into a Shazam fingerprint on your phone, and shows the song and artist with Copy and YouTube Music. Only the fingerprint goes to Shazam, never the audio, and only when you use the gesture. The fingerprint code is ported from SongRec.
- `Unfollow accounts that don't follow you back` is new under Privacy > Clean up your account. It reads who you follow and your followers first, with a running count and Stop, then tells you how many it found and counts down with Cancel before it unfollows them one at a time. An account only counts when your Following list marks it as followed and not mutual and it isn't on your followers list, so the people who follow you back stay followed.
- `Show what changed since your last visit`, under Profile, puts a line under the @username when you come back to a profile, like "Since Nov 18: +12 followers, +1 video". It covers followers, following, likes and videos. When your last visit was earlier the same day, it shows the time instead of the date. The counts stay on your phone, nothing is recorded while the switch is off, and a profile you haven't opened before shows nothing until your next visit. It starts off.
- `Export followers and following`, under Profile, saves your followers or the accounts you follow as a CSV file in Download/Hushfeed. Each row has the username, name, profile link and IDs, plus whether you follow each other. The list is read at about the pace of scrolling it, with a count and Stop, up to 10,000 accounts. Stop keeps the ones read so far, and the notice says the file is partial.
- `Save your likes from a TikTok data export`, under Downloads, saves the videos you liked or favorited. Ask TikTok for your data in JSON format (Settings and privacy > Account > Download your data), then pick the file it sends you, or the zip it comes in. Hushfeed tells you how many liked videos and favorites it found and you tick which to save. They save one after another with a count and Cancel, up to 1,000 per run. With `Check for already-saved videos` on, the ones you saved before are skipped, so picking the same file again carries on where the last run stopped. Videos TikTok doesn't have anymore are counted at the end.
- Ghost mode has a new switch, `Keep likes on this phone`. With it on, a like you give a video turns the heart red but never reaches TikTok, so the creator isn't told and the video stays off your profile's Liked tab. The heart is still red after you reopen TikTok. Unliking one takes it back on the phone. Unliking a video you liked before turning it on still goes to TikTok. `My likes on this phone`, right under it, lists them newest first and opens each video. TikTok's like count doesn't include them, and comment likes still go out.
- AMOLED dark theme has a new option, `Switch in Hushfeed settings`. It's on unless you turn it off, so your builds stay the same. Off, it leaves out the AMOLED dark mode switch, whose hooks change more of TikTok's code than any other Hushfeed patch, so patching needs less memory, and dark mode stays black. On a computer with every Hushfeed patch picked, the patcher rebuilt 1,777 classes with it off and 2,513 with it on.
- TikTok Lite 47.8.2 gets its first Hushfeed patches: Settings, Diagnostic tools, Feed filter, Change app name, Trust user certificates, Disable screen capture detection, Network request report, Block contact list access, Block installed app scanning, In-app browser privacy guard and Camera and microphone indicator. Lite has no For You tab to hold, so press and hold the app's icon and pick Open Hushfeed settings. The Feed filter works on For You and leaves a profile's videos and a video you opened alone (#48).
- `Liquid glass when held` brings the glass lens to your finger now, and it swells more. Move your finger along the bar and the lens goes with it, tab to tab, then slides back to your tab when you let go. The tab under it grows, and on Android 13 and up the tabs bend and split into color at the lens's edge, the way the video does with `Blur the video behind the bar` (#440).
- With `Keep watching in a small window` on, a LIVE's small window now has previous and next buttons, like a video's. They move to the LIVE above or below the way a swipe does, Record (or TikTok's own button) sits between them, and the one with no LIVE its way shows dimmed (#413).
- A save that a server turns down now shows up in the diagnostic report's new SAVE REFUSALS section. It names the server, says how it refused (like HTTP 403), and tells whether the save's link had already expired. Before, each refused address only read "url omitted" (#464).
- The diagnostic report's DOWNLOAD PICKER section also lists what's in the video models TikTok keeps beside a video's qualities, each rendition by name and height, so a report can show whether one of them is taller than what Save offers (#471).
- When TikTok freezes ("isn't responding") or crashes in native code, the last exits in the diagnostic report now show the stack Android kept. A freeze lists the main thread's top 40 frames, and a native crash lists its signal and the crashing thread. Android 17's memory limiter and anomaly exits are named too, where the report used to show a bare number.
- Holding one of TikTok's own stickers in a chat now shows Save media in the menu that opens. It saves the full sticker the same way Save in the sticker box does, and turning off `Save box for chat stickers` takes it away too (#470).
- `Show the picture before saving`, under `Save a profile picture on a long press`, opens a held profile picture full screen at full size first. Save under it saves the picture, and a tap anywhere else closes it. It starts off (#467).
- `Report a newer phone to game LIVE` under App tells TikTok's LIVE server you have a Galaxy S25 Ultra while you set up a LIVE. If the server keeps a game LIVE under 1080p 60fps because of your phone, this gives it another chance. It starts off (#459).
- `Seconds per photo` now goes up to 300, so a photo can stay on screen for up to five minutes in a video made from a photo post (#465).
- The "Save photos or a video?" question has a seconds box now, filled in with `Seconds per photo`. Change it there and that video uses it, and so does the next one, with no trip to settings (#465).
- Picking photos and videos together in a photo post asks "Save photos or a video?" too. Save as video makes one video with each picked video playing in its place between the photos and the post's sound under all of it. Save photos still saves each one as it is (#465).
- A video made from a post with just one photo runs as long as the post's sound now, up to five minutes, so the music plays to its end instead of stopping when `Seconds per photo` runs out (#469).
- `Sort pinned videos with the rest` lets a profile's sort put pinned videos in the order with everything else, so Newest first shows them at the date they were posted instead of at the top. It starts off (#466).
- `Hide or reorder profile tabs` (it used to be `Hide profile tabs`) now has arrows on each tab. Move Liked to the top and it's first on your profile, while the tabs you didn't touch stay where TikTok puts them. `Original order` puts TikTok's back (#466).
- `Hide Add bio` under App takes the Add bio prompt off your own profile while it has no bio. Edit profile still lets you add one. It starts off (#466).
- `Hide the people you may know tag` under Feed screen takes that tag away from beside a creator's name. The Friends and Following labels stay (#462).
- `Hide inserted cards` takes the full-screen people you may know card out of For You too. TikTok doesn't even ask for it while the switch is on, and if one shows up anyway it's dropped from the feed (#478).
- `Hide stories from accounts you don't follow` clears the recommended stories TikTok mixes into the Inbox's stories tray. Stories from accounts you follow, and your own, stay (#462).
- `LIVE buttons in the long-press menu` takes Record and Auto tap off the video and puts them in the menu you get by holding the middle of a LIVE. TikTok won't open that menu right after a like, so while Auto tap runs, holding the LIVE stops it instead. Hold again and the menu opens (#359).
- `Fade the name, date and caption` gives the creator's name, the date, the caption and the music line their own opacity over the video (#462).
- `Write the month as a word` shows TikTok's date by the creator's name as Oct 12, or 12 Oct with `Day before month` on (#461).
- `Use an imported emoji font` draws emoji in a font file you pick, separately from the text font. It's part of `Use system font` and needs Android 12 or newer (#458).
- `Video bitrate limit` keeps a heavy video from eating your data. Anything over the limit plays a lighter version, and videos under it aren't touched (#454).
- Double tap and Long press can mark the video on screen as not interested, with the same follow-up choices as the button. It needs the Not interested patch (#452).
- The diagnostic report says when TikTok's main screen starts over while the app is still running, and what happened to the screen before it. That's what a feed jumping back to the top with no crash looks like (#419).
- With `Stop recording watch history` in the patch set, the diagnostic report counts TikTok's view reports, the ones Watch history is built from. It shows how many were made and how many TikTok groups into one send. Then it counts the ones sent on their own, sent together, dropped because TikTok's server told the app to slow down, held back by `Keep videos out of Watch history` or failed, with the last failure's reason (#448).
- The diagnostic report's IMAGE LOADS section counts failed images by how they failed, not one line per picture, so a few hundred refusals from one server read as one line with a count. Request headers in a failure show their names only, never their values. The section also says which country TikTok has placed your phone in and how it decided, next to the SIM country Hushfeed is showing it, so a report can tell when the two don't match (#415).
- `Freeze TikTok's experiments` under App keeps the settings TikTok's servers already sent and ignores new ones, so a layout or feature TikTok starts testing on your account doesn't show up out of nowhere. If something in TikTok stops working, turn it off so the fix can reach you. It starts off. The switch has been in the patches since 0.81.0 without a note here.
- Hushfeed moves to TikTok 47.9.3, and only that one. 47.8.3 isn't supported anymore. Get the 47.9.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with your usual signing key.

Bug Fixes

- With `Copy the link with one press on Share` on, the Share button's screen reader label says it copies the link as soon as a video shows. Before, it kept TikTok's usual Share label until you'd pressed the button once.
- Searching for a product no longer logs an error, or shows an error toast with diagnostic logging on, when TikTok or the videos themselves mark every result on a page as an advert. The page still shows as TikTok sent it, and the diagnostic report says why. A page where every card carries an advert's shape still counts as an error, since that points at a broken check.
- On a tablet held sideways, opening a profile from search or a picture in the comments no longer flips the screen to portrait. The new `Turn profiles and comment pictures on tablets` patch has both turn with the rest of TikTok wherever TikTok's own check lets its main screen turn. Phones aren't affected (#490).
- With `Translate button in comments` on, the suggested search at the top of the comments stops before the translate button instead of running under it (#479).
- `Translate button in comments` now offers the restart button when you flip it. TikTok keeps one comment sheet for the whole feed and only checks for the button when it builds that sheet, so the change waited for a restart anyway.
- `Remove feed ads` takes another kind of search ad out of the results. Some search ads carry their video tucked inside the card rather than on it, and TikTok itself doesn't call them ads when asked, so they stayed in the grid (#484).
- With `Floating bottom bar` and `Hide the bottom tab names` on, the bar lines each tab up by its icon, and an empty box inside a tab doesn't count as the icon anymore. TikTok's Create tab can carry one, and lining up by it could leave the + sitting higher than the other icons (#474).
- TikTok doesn't freeze and crash anymore with thousands of offline videos saved. Every few minutes TikTok checked how many saved videos were still unwatched by loading all of them, and with a big `Custom offline videos limit` that filled its memory. It asks the database for the number now (#482).
- With `Slide to change the hold speed` on, pulling down to lock keeps the speed the bubble shows on every video. Once a lock carried its speed into the next videos, TikTok counted each of them as locked already, so a slide and a pull there unlocked the video and dropped it to 1x instead. A pull without sliding still unlocks (#485).
- `My watch history` is up to date when you come back to it from a video you opened in it. It used to show the list from before you left until you closed and reopened it.
- The checklist under `Hide Settings and privacy rows` now names the rows the way TikTok 47.9.3 shows them, in the same order as the page, and it has the Visibility and Interactions rows too, like Blocked accounts, Mentions and Direct messages. Before, those showed up under made-up names like "Shared links", and a few others still had their old labels, like Inbox mode for what's now Inbox & Messaging. In German, Italian, Russian and five more languages, Family Pairing now has TikTok's current name too (#244).
- With `Bottom bar height` on anything but TikTok default, the tab icons no longer sit on top of their names. TikTok pads its tabs differently once the bar's room isn't the size it expects, and the new height counted as unexpected, so the icon and the name got pushed into each other. On a taller bar they keep the same gap as on TikTok's own bar now. On a shorter one they shrink a little with the bar, so the selected tab's outline still fits around them.
- With `Bottom bar height` on Tall or Taller, the search strip at the bottom of a video no longer slides under the bar, and on Short or Shorter it no longer floats above the bar with a gap. The caption, the strip and its progress line keep TikTok's distance from the bar at every height now.
- TikTok no longer crashes a few seconds after launch on some phones with "Final field cannot be written to". The Feed filter's check on videos TikTok saved for later wrote a value TikTok had marked read-only (#472).
- With `Log diagnostics` on, Hushfeed settings no longer log a failure for the App icon row each time the page opens or refreshes. It stays out of the diagnostic report, and `Show failures on screen` doesn't pop an error for it anymore. That row saves nothing, so it was never a missing setting.
- `Copy quick report` puts the report together in the background, so the settings page no longer stalls while it reads saved crashes. The other patch bundles line is filled in on the first copy too, where it used to ask you to copy again.
- Native crash lines in the diagnostic report keep their function names. A name like `HttpNetworkSession::GetSocketPool` read as a session value and was blanked.
- The Feature gate lab's list of TikTok settings is right where TikTok's code branches. A few entries were named after a setting loaded on another path, or showed another setting's default, and some settings read after a jump weren't listed at all.
- `Show account country` and `Block this commenter` show up when you hold a comment on accounts where TikTok is trying out its newer share-style comment menu. That menu never got the rows. With either switch on, TikTok opens its regular menu instead, and the share button on comments stays (#417).
- With `Keep the middle unstretched` on, search results play in the app's window like the feed does. A search video on a layer of its own used to leave every video cropped and stretched until the next restart (#468).
- With `Keep the middle unstretched` on, a video's cover picture keeps the same size as its video. When TikTok played a video on a layer of its own, the cover could still take the whole screen, so it showed at the wrong size and flickered as the video replaced it. Once that happens the video and its cover are both cropped and stretched evenly, and the diagnostic report says so (#468).
- Searching the settings for `SIM country preset`, or just "preset", finds that row now. It used to find nothing.
- With `Auto-advance videos` and `Keep playing in the background` both on, a creator's videos keep coming after you start one from their profile and leave the app. TikTok used to play that first video and stop. `Auto-advance session limit` counts these too, and screen-time holds stop them the same way (D292).
- A copy made with Morphe's `Clone app` can log in with the default selection now. `Run beside the store app` is part of Simple mode, and it does nothing on a copy that keeps TikTok's own package name. Without it, TikTok's servers wouldn't give the renamed copy a device ID, so every login said you'd hit the maximum number of attempts (#455, #284).
- The date and length on profile grids don't get cut in half anymore. The label's bar now grows when it needs a third line (#449, #462).
- Patching no longer stops at `Settings` when TikTok's Open Debug row can't be found. You lose only the Hushfeed row in TikTok's settings, and holding Home still opens the page (#460).
- `Save episodes` loads a mini drama's episode list again. It used to stop at "Couldn't load the episodes" (#463).
- The `Save episodes` list goes past the free episodes of a drama you haven't unlocked, and saving one of those gets the whole episode. TikTok's list sends those episodes without their video, so Hushfeed asks for each one on its own instead of stopping at "This video isn't available as a complete file" (#463).
- When TikTok's server turns down every copy of an original photo, `Download original photos` saves the copy TikTok shows on screen instead of stopping at "None of the photos could be saved" (#464).
- With `Hide suggested accounts` on, following someone doesn't leave an empty Suggested accounts box on their profile anymore. Turn on `Keep suggestions on profiles` if you'd rather keep that row while the other suggestions stay hidden (#462).
- `Play original audio` also covers videos TikTok dubs with a whole second copy of the video, which is how some mini dramas get theirs. Saving one of those with the switch on keeps the original sound too (#463, #444).
- The note on the `White on black`, `Black on white` and `Material You` app icons, and on themed icons, has clean round edges now. TikTok's own note has dents that its colored echoes normally cover.
- `Keep captions in Clear display` shows a video's first caption right away, sits near TikTok's own caption spot when it hasn't seen one yet, and stays above the progress bar (#456).
- The country and date line doesn't get cut off anymore when you open a long caption, and the caption above it keeps every line after you open or close it with more and less (#457).
- `Show the country and date under the caption` keeps the two together on photo posts and on videos with no caption. With no caption they go right under the creator's name (#453).
- A sorted profile grid loads up to 1,000 videos on its own before it sorts, up from 300, so a long profile's oldest and longest videos make it into the order. On a long profile that takes around 35 seconds. Tap the loading grid to see the order it has right away, and your scrolling loads the rest. A slow connection stops after 45 seconds the same way. The notes under the profile and sound page sort settings say 1,000 now too, where they still said 300 (#180).
- With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the Unmute and Remove buttons in a LIVE's Muted and Blocked lists show their label in white. The buttons are a see-through gray on the dark sheet and the label stayed dark gray on them, so you could barely read it (#362).
- With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, every row of a LIVE's Muted, Blocked and Moderation lists stays readable as you scroll. Rows the list brought in while scrolling kept their dark gray text on the dark sheet, and the readable ones seemed to jump around as the list reused them (#362).
- With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, an outlined button on a LIVE settings page gets a white outline with its label inside it. The white filled the whole button, so the Moderation list's buttons showed up as blank white boxes (#362).
- With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the "Find an open guest spot" bar under a LIVE guest's card reads light on a dark gray bar. TikTok always draws that bar in its light colors, so its text and arrow were black on the black sheet (#362).
- With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a pinned comment's Pinned and timer tags sit right on the video again, the way they look with the switch off. They still had pale see-through pills behind them, because the comment's rows took the colors meant for the dark panels (#362).

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfeed source.
2. Patch TikTok 47.9.3 from APKMirror. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed#install).
